thread:
Aisha: Quick kickoff for Ambassador Inc onboarding — tagging stakeholders. Key constraints: data residency (eu-only), SSO not set, and we need a sample dataset. Proposed 30/60 plan + 3 enablement sessions this month. Who's in for a sync today 3pm PT?

Tom: I can take the integration checklist and perf baseline. 3pm PT works.

Marta (Ambassador): Thanks Aisha. 3pm PT good. Quick note: legal needs DPIA signoff before data leaves our environment.

Jules: I'll run the onboarding playbook. I'll send the meeting invite and a short pre-read (steps + access matrix). Can someone confirm who has admin on their Okta?

Marta (Ambassador): @marta-okta-admin is cc'd, she'll confirm.

Priya (Eng): We'll need temporary service account creds and a subdomain to test routing. ETA for SSO setup?

Marta (Ambassador): Okta admin says earliest EOD Wednesday.

Aisha: Risks: if SSO delays > 5d then pilot shift. Success criteria (CS team proposes):
- Live inference end-to-end with sample dataset
- p95 latency < 200ms for 512 tokens
- Embeddings indexing + recall >= 0.82 on eval set
- Support trained and onboarded (internal playbook run)

Tom: I'll own latency checks and the eval run. Can someone drop the eval set access to s3:ambassador-onboard/samples?

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: Today 15:00 PT — https://cal.example.com/meet/1790123456 :spiral_calendar: 

Jules: I'll add a 7-day checkpoint doc in Confluence and ping for a 30d rollout decision. @Aisha can you own renewal risk assessment (we'll flag legal timeline)?

Aisha: Yep, I'll own renewal risk & health. Will create a short scorecard: adoption metrics + technical blockers.

Marta (Ambassador): One more ask: can Redwood share a simple runbook for fallback strategy (if primary region backpressure)? Legal wants continuity docs.

Tom: I'll draft a 1-pager and post it here by EOD.

Aisha: Awesome — next steps: 1) confirm SSO admin by EOD, 2) share sample dataset link, 3) Tom to prep perf harness, 4) Jules to send invite + checklist. :thumbsup:

Marta (Ambassador): :thumbsup: thanks all.
